title: Analyze Full Project
description: Perform a holistic analysis of an entire project, uploaded or from Git.

results.noResults: No results yet. Perform an analysis to start.
results.modificationInputLabel: Describe the modification you want to apply to the project:
results.modificationInputPlaceholder: E.g.: Add a 'logger.js' file in the 'src/utils' folder.

results.defaultChatContextSystemPrompt: You are an AI assistant expert in code analysis. The user will ask questions or request modifications about the previously generated project analysis. Respond concisely and helpfully in English.
